DeepSeek V4.1 prompt encoding
===========================

`deepseek_v41.py` is the unmodified official `encoding/encoding.py` from
https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash/tree/dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277/encoding

Revision: `dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277`.
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 DeepSeek; see DEEPSEEK_LICENSE.

This is the authoritative V4.1 chat template (Python encoder, not Jinja).
The model in this repository is text-only; its adapter rejects image inputs.
